source_note: Labour Code of the Republic of Armenia ՀՕ-124-Ն (arlis.am redaction 23.12.2022-06.04.2023; owner confirmed current 22 Nov 2026). Quotes and article reading in docs/legal/PRE_REVIEW.md. Lawyer must confirm.
basis: Art. 159(1): minimum 20 working days (five-day week) / 24 (six-day week). Art. 164(1): working year counted from the hire date. Art. 167(3): postponed leave may be granted within 18 months after the end of the working year.

title.hy: Վերջին աշխատանքային տարում տրամադրված տարեկան արձակուրդը նվազագույնից պակաս է
title.ru: За последний рабочий год ежегодного отпуска предоставлено меньше минимума
title.en: Annual leave granted in the last working year is below the minimum

edge_cases: Judges only the latest working year whose 18-month postponement window (Art. 167(3)) has passed, so a recent year is never flagged.
Leave starting inside that year or inside the window counts (carry-over allowed); this can only hide a shortfall.
Skipped only when the company has no leave records at all; once any leave exists, employees with none are checked (0 days taken). A skipped rule never auto-resolves an open finding.
Checks the minimum only: extended and additional leave (Art. 160, 161) are above the floor and not modelled; part-time does not shorten leave (Art. 159(2)).
Split-leave rule (Art. 163: one part at least 10/12 working days) not modelled.
Counts recorded working days, not calendar days.
